explication_en: The plugin/dropbar.lua file loads the main module, which applies configs.lua and builds the winbar in bar.lua. The latter queries sources (LSP, Tree-sitter, path, Markdown) in cascade and opens dropdown menus, with optional fuzzy search via utils/fzf.lua.
